Both get credits worth 100% of their November platform fees, applied as credit memos on their December invoices — no cash: **Loomly $18,400** and **Pinecrest Rentals $6,200**, $24,600 total [1][5][8]. That replaced the initial 50% proposal (~$9.2k / ~$3.1k) [4], and both amounts are already committed in writing to the customers [5][8].

And yes, it's in the November books: Marcus decided on a contra-revenue accrual in November (Dr Revenue – service credits $24,600 / Cr Accrued customer credits), reversing when the December credit memos go out, with the JE description handed to Jenna [1]. The close checklist shows "Service credits accrual – payout incident (Loomly, Pinecrest)" as *In progress* [7].

One thing deliberately left out: Loomly's request to reimburse $7,690 of overdraft fees for 214 sellers is **not** accrued in November — it was still undecided at close, so it's only flagged as an open item in the close memo, with an answer promised to Loomly by Nov 25 [1][5].
